tldr: Each workflow run now writes a log row: completed, halted or error. The workflow editor shows these logs in a new modal.
goal: Users cannot see which step stopped a workflow run or which asset triggered it.

story.heading: Database stores one log row per run
story.body: The new workflow_log table stores the result, the last step and the trigger asset.

story.heading: API contract defines the log DTOs
story.body: A log entry DTO and a logs query DTO set the response and the filters: result, before and limit.

story.heading: Workflows write a log when a run ends
story.body: A run ends as completed, halted or error. The run writes a log row when the workflow has logging on.

story.heading: Web app shows run logs in a modal
story.body: The workflow editor opens a modal that lists the run logs of the workflow.

story.heading: Workflow log table added
story.body: Each log row belongs to one workflow and an optional workflow step.

story.heading: Workflows gain a run log shown in the editor
story.body: Each run result is stored and returned by a new endpoint, GET /workflows/:id/logs.

components.summary: Opens a logs modal in the workflow editor that lists the run results.
Adds one line to the OpenAPI patch for the Dart client.
Exports getWorkflowLogs() and the log types, generated from the OpenAPI spec.
Adds GET /workflows/:id/logs, guarded by the WorkflowLogs permission.
Writes a log row when a run ends, if logging is on. Returns the logs of a workflow.
Adds the WorkflowLogs permission to the access checks.
Stores run logs in the workflow_log table and reads them with a query.
Defines the log entry DTO and the logs query DTO with their filters.
Adds the WorkflowResult enum: completed, halted or error.

decisions.title: Store logs in their own table
decisions.why: Each run adds one row, so the logs do not change the workflow definition.

decisions.title: Log only when the workflow enables logging
decisions.why: The execution code checks workflow.logging before each write, so logging is opt-in per workflow.

decisions.title: Return from a halted run instead of breaking the loop
decisions.why: A halted run logs its result and stops. Before, the loop broke and the run logged nothing.

flows.title: List the logs of a workflow
Record the result of a workflow run
